items.lang|foxablazeaqzl_wiki|foxablazeaqzl_wi:
Everything I desire shall ultimately become wealth that belongs to me alone.

Acquisition Requirements
Master Greed.
Become a True Demon Lord or True Hero.
Permanently consume 1,000,000 maximum Magicules.

Active
[Active - Press] Life Steal: Steal 1% of the target's EP and add it to your own. Your EP must be higher than the target's. Each attempt costs 3,000 Magicules. Cooldown: 10 seconds on success, 3 seconds on failure.

[Active - Press] Heart Control: Control a creature whose EP is lower than your own. Costs 2,500 Magicules. Cooldown: 60 seconds.

[Active - Press] Skill Steal: Steal a skill from a creature or player, excluding Unique and Ultimate Skills. The skill is removed from the target and transferred to you rather than copied. Each target can only have a skill successfully stolen once. Each attempt costs 10,000 Magicules. Cooldown: 30 seconds on success, 3 seconds on failure.

[Active - Hold] Mental Domination: Hold while looking at a target to place them under your control. The base duration is 60 seconds. Within 5 blocks, this duration is reduced by 30 seconds. Beyond 20 blocks, it increases by 30 seconds. Maximum range: 30 blocks. Targeting a non-player creature adds another 30 seconds. When targeting a player, each Desire Point reduces the required time by 1 second. One Desire Point equals 10 villager trades. Each recorded trade belonging to a targeted merchant NPC reduces the required time by 2 seconds. You must keep looking at the target, or your progress will decrease. Activate while sneaking to release a controlled target.

[Active - Toggle] Greed Flare: Activate without looking at a target to gain a buff that increases your physical attack damage by 20% of your current Spiritual Health divided by your race's Spiritual Health multiplier. Formula: Spiritual Health / Y / 5, where Y is the racial Spiritual Health multiplier. Activate again to disable it. Each hit consumes Magicules equal to 10 times the bonus damage.
Activate while looking at an ally to grant them a buff equal to 10% of their current Spiritual Health divided by their race's Spiritual Health multiplier. Formula: Spiritual Health / Y / 10. Costs Magicules equal to 20 times the bonus damage.
Activate while looking at a creature within 20 blocks to deal damage equal to your Spiritual Health / Y / 10. Costs Magicules equal to 20 times the damage dealt. Cooldown: 120 seconds.

[Active - Hold] Death Wish: Hold while looking at a creature within 5 blocks for 200 ticks to kill them instantly. Costs 1,000 Magicules. You must keep looking at the target, or your progress will decrease.

[Active - Press] Multilayer Barrier: Sets your Barrier Points to 1.5 times your maximum health. Incoming damage below the Barrier Point threshold consumes your Magicules at a rate of 5 Magicules per point of damage. An attack exceeding the threshold reduces your Barrier Points to zero, and its damage is reduced by the number of Barrier Points you had.

Passive
[Passive - Toggle] Increases your magic casting speed multiplier by 2, movement speed by 0.01, and attack speed by 0.2. Once mastered, the movement speed bonus increases to 0.02 and the attack speed bonus increases to 0.4.

Channel your inner darkness to burn and blind nearby opponents.

Passive
Grants access to the intermediate level of Dark Spirit Magic
Active
[Active - Hold] - At the cost of 30 MP per 20 ticks held down and 50% speed, deal 2 Dark damage and apply Darkness Effect for all mobs within a 10x10 area

Turn the strength of your opponents into your own and turn the tides of battle. Copy abilities when you are struck by them, provided you meet the necessary conditions.

Passive
[ Passive - In Slot ] - Copy: The user can copy an ability's specific mode after being hit or affected by it when [Pride]'s Copy Mode is in slot. Without mastery, it will only be able to copy attacks, such as Absolute Severance. Once mastered, [Pride] will be able to copy abilities when inflicted with status effects like Infinity Prison's Imprison or Healer's Infection. Note that [Pride] won't be able to copy any spirit related magic
[Pride]'s Mastery gain is based on the copied ability's cost, (Example: you get 1 point per 2500 MP cost, so if the ability costs 10K to acquire, you get 4 mastery points) while cooldown is 5s. On a failed copy, [Pride] will only gain 10% of the mastery it would've gained on a successful copying of the ability, but the cooldown is similarly reduced to 10%.
Once a mode is successfully copied, the user will pay the whole ability's obtainment cost and [Pride] will go on cooldown. The copied mode will be added as a new Mode for [Pride] (If this mode requires learning, it will be instantly learnt once acquired). As this is a new mode on [Pride] itself, the copied skill's passive features won't be usable and a mode may be unusable if it depends on said passive features or other modes of the ability.
Active
[ Active - Press ] - Copy: Opens a new GUI that allows the user to quickly equip or remove copied ability modes.

Project your aura to cow nearby foes into submission.

Active
[Active - Hold] - 25 MP each 20 ticks. When activated 5% Speed (10% with mastery), all mobs within a 30x30 radius are affected. With mastery, scroll while holding down the skill button to change the percentage of EP used for calculation. If their EP is =<75% of the user's used EP, it does nothing. Otherwise, give 1 Fear level for each 20% difference with the used EP.

Unleash a primal fury and gain a massive physical boost to crush your enemies.

[Active - Press] - Fully heals the player and restores their MP and AP, gives them a Strength 10-equivalent damage increase, 20 armor points and +0.08 Speed, and temporarily increases their maximum MP and AP by 2x. Grants the player creative flight. It lasts for 3 Minutes and upon ending inflicts the player with Paralysis 2, Fragility 2, and Weakness 2 for 10 Minutes. 20 Minute Cooldown [1 Day]. Mastery increases the duration to 6 Minutes. 0 MP

Absorb all in your path. None can win. Receive and provide skills, gain access to a spatial storage and mimic entities.

Active
[Active - Hold] Predation: On use, creates a black mist (breath) up to a 10 block (shifting and using the ability will change the block consumption between only blocks, liquids or both, slideable range with scroll mouse. Max 15 with mastery) radius in front of the player If it comes into contact with a mob, deals 50 damage, applies Corrosion for 5 seconds, and drains 1000 MP, with a 30% chance to gain 1-3 random Intrinsic, Common, Extra, or Resists skill/s from the target. If an enemy is killed by Predation, gains all of their Intrinsic, Common, Extra and Resists skills. With Mastery, if a Magic projectile is eaten, then the player gains that magic. For the first time killing a type of mob, targets killed have 50% (Configurable) of their ep added to the players max instead of the usual 3%. This can be toggled to consume blocks using shift + ability key while on the predation mode, which will automatically be added to Stomach.
Active: [Active - Press] Stomach: When activated, grants access to a spatial storage with the size of a chest with 9 rows. Items are able to be stacked to 666 instead of 64.
Active: [Active - Hold] Corrosion: Costs 200 MP and deals 10 Corrosion damage every 10 ticks to all enemies in a 10x10 radius. Enemies killed by this have their Resists, Intrinsic, Common, and Extra Skills taken by the player.
Active: [Active - Press] Receive: Intrinsic, Common, and Extra skills owned by the player's subordinates are given to the player.
Active: [Active - Press] Isolation: Consumes held item and restores mp similar to Absorb and Dissolve, but with twice the restored mp. If nothing is held and the player is looking at a target, remove all negative status effects from that target. If used while empty handed and not looking at a mob, removes all negative status effects from the player [Costs 100 MP each effect level removed].
